india.one_line: India invests in AI infrastructure and defence AI capabilities.

themes.title: Tata Communications builds AI fibre network
themes.text: Tata Communications will invest up to $450 million to construct a 10,000 km high‑speed fibre network linking AI data‑centre corridors, starting with the Mumbai‑Pune‑Hyderabad‑Chennai route, targeting hyperscalers, AI platforms, enterprises and a connectivity market over $1 billion.

stories.headline: Tata Communications to invest $450 million in 10,000 km AI network in India
Tata Communications to spend $450 million on 10,000 km AI‑ready fibre network in India

themes.title: MoU for AI defence applications
themes.text: India's Ministry of Defence signed a five‑year MoU with Sarvam AI to develop and deploy AI tools for the Army, Navy and Air Force, covering decision support, target acquisition and data fusion while retaining human oversight.

stories.headline: India's Ministry of Defence signs AI partnership with Sarvam
